name: Rellinars (Spain)
description: Purple field with a yellow bend over a white bend sinister, and three white six-pointed stars in the spaces between them.
history: The flag was approved on 19 May 2003 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3900; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, purple, with a yellow bend and a white bend sinister each 1/6 of the height, the bend above the bend sinister, and three white six-pointed stars of diameter 1/6 of the height, all equidistant from the bend and the bend sinister.

features.role: bend 1/6 of the height, over the bend sinister
bend sinister 1/6 of the height beneath the bend
three stars equidistant from the bend and bend sinister
